items.title: Urbie Green interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 29, 1995
items.q: I got to meet all those people. I got to know them.

ctx.x: Buddy Tate. A lot of people. I got to meet all those people. I got to know them. It was wonderful. Hang out with Coleman Hawkins, boy, something.
Did you ever have occasion to work with or be influenced in any way by J.J. Johnson?
